description: This file defines functions for creating and managing various types of elements in the Excalidraw drawing application, including text, images, lines, arrows, frames, and freehand drawings. It includes utility functions for element positioning, dimension adjustments, and element instantiation with default properties.

methods.name: _newElementBase
methods.description: Internal function to create a new element with default properties and type-specific settings.

methods.name: newElement
methods.description: Creates a new generic element with specified type and options.

methods.name: newFrameElement
methods.description: Creates a new frame element with optional name.

methods.name: newMagicFrameElement
methods.description: Creates a new magic frame element with optional name.

methods.name: newTextElement
methods.description: Creates a new text element with text, font, alignment, and positioning.

methods.name: refreshTextDimensions
methods.description: Recalculates and updates the dimensions of a text element based on its content and container.

methods.name: newFreeDrawElement
methods.description: Creates a new freehand drawing element with points and pressure data.

methods.name: newLinearElement
methods.description: Creates a new linear (polyline or polygon) element with points.

methods.name: newArrowElement
methods.description: Creates a new arrow element, either straight or elbowed, with optional arrowheads.

methods.name: newImageElement
methods.description: Creates a new image element with optional status, file ID, scale, and crop.
